name: SensTech Automation India Pvt Ltd
target_segment: Indian Tier-2 & Tier-3 SME Machine Shops
positioning: Low-cost local automation with domestic servicing network
pricing: ₹6,00,000 - ₹9,00,000 per retrofit arm (40-50% lower than Japanese imports)
strengths: Extensive nationwide field engineering presence across Pune, Coimbatore, and Rajkot
Billing directly in INR with zero FX risk for local SMEs
Fast turnaround on replacement mechanical parts
weaknesses: Higher failure rate in precision CNC micro-assembly
No proprietary edge AI optical torque sensing
Limited safety certifications for cage-free collaboration
visible_gap: Lacks high-precision optical torque feedback and low electrical power draw required by modern EMS assemblers.

name: Universal Robots India (Teradyne)
target_segment: Tier-1 Automotive OEMs and Global Electronics Manufacturers
positioning: Premium global market leader with extensive ecosystem (UR+)
strengths: Market leader brand recognition in Indian automotive assembly lines (Tata, Mahindra)
Vast network of certified local system integrators
weaknesses: High acquisition cost prohibitive for Indian SMEs
Higher electrical power consumption compared to ultra-compact Japanese arms
visible_gap: Too expensive for sub-₹15 Lakh budget threshold of Indian SME machine shops.

name: Fanuc India Pvt Ltd
target_segment: High-volume automotive and heavy industrial machinery
positioning: Industrial gold standard for continuous heavy-duty CNC machining
strengths: Massive installed base in Indian CNC tooling corridor (Bengaluru Technology Center)
Direct Japanese factory backing and engineering depth
weaknesses: Heavier footprint not optimized for compact table-top electronics assembly
Complex integration requiring specialized Fanuc programmers
visible_gap: Over-engineered for lightweight electronics assembly and SME high-mix low-volume setups.
